summary: CR-482 P11-P15 retest after the F8/Radix Toast fix, run on the preview URL against preprod (owner@cafe103.com). A window-capture click interceptor blocked every place-order-btn and order-entry-print-bill-btn-* click, so no orders were placed, nothing was printed and no bills were settled. 23/23 checks passed. F8-TOAST-FIX: F8 in search clicks place-order and focus stays in the search input (not an OL). F9 straight after F8 opens collect-payment-panel. F8 then F4 keeps focus in search. F8-SEQUENCE: F8, F2, F4, F9 each work; keydown log shows defaultPrevented true and activeElement INPUT for every key. F8 from a grid item or cart row keeps focus on that element, and F9 afterwards still works. F4-NO-BUTTON: on new table C2 (no print button), F4 from a grid item, from body or from a cart row leaves focus where it was and does not jump to search. On C1 (#021102), F4 clicks order-entry-print-bill-btn-1537752 (intercepted) and refocuses search. F8 then F4 on C1 also works. OFF-REGRESSION: with the flag false (kbd-focus-trap-end absent), F8 on the dashboard, in OE search and from body never moves focus to an OL, and place-order is not clicked. Gating: F8, F4 and F9 do nothing in the quick-customer-name input. F2 and F8 do nothing while the dynamic-price modal (item 'test1') is open.
action_items: Optional (minor UX): after closing the Collect Payment panel with payment-back-btn while shortcuts are ON, document.activeElement is BODY, not the search input. Shortcuts still work from body, but scanner/typing input is lost until F2. Consider refocusing search when the panel closes if kbdEnabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: toaster.jsx L30 <ToastViewport hotkey={[]} />. Radix checks hotkey.length !== 0, so the document F8 listener is now a no-op everywhere, with shortcuts ON or OFF.
Fix verified: OrderEntry.jsx L675-677. The F4 refocus is now gated on clickIfEnabled() returning true.

Still open from iteration_20 (not in scope): clickIfEnabled `el.style.display !== 'fixed'` is meaningless (likely meant getComputedStyle position). The duplicated 'allowed' active-element check in F8/F4/F9 should be extracted into a helper. OrderEntry.jsx is about 3200 lines.
Side effect of hotkey={[]}: the Radix toast viewport no longer has a keyboard shortcut for accessibility. This is acceptable, but note it if a11y is a requirement.
